IBNKATHIR:89:23/r2.anchor: عن عبد الله بن مسعود ، قوله ولم يرفعه

IBNKATHIR:89:23/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:89:23/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:89:23/r3.claim: On that day each person remembers his deeds and what he sent ahead in earlier and more recent times.
IBNKATHIR:89:23/r3.anchor: أي : عمله وما كان أسلفه في قديم دهره وحديثه

IBNKATHIR:89:23/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR:89:23/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR:89:23/r4.claim: Ibn Kathir explains the question as meaning: how could remembering benefit the person then?

MAWARDI:89:23/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:89:23/r1.speaker: الضحاك
MAWARDI:89:23/r1.claim: The person remembers by repenting, but repentance on the Day of Resurrection cannot benefit them.
MAWARDI:89:23/r1.anchor: أحدهما : يتوب وكيف له بالتوبة ، لأن التوبة بالقيامة لا تنفع ، قاله الضحاك

MAWARDI:89:23/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI:89:23/r2.speaker: ابن شجرة
MAWARDI:89:23/r2.claim: The person remembers worldly deeds and what they sent ahead for the Hereafter, but remembrance benefits only in worldly life.
MAWARDI:89:23/r2.anchor: الثاني : يتذكر ما عمل في دنياه وما قدم لآخرته ، وأنى له الذكرى في الآخرة ، وإنما ينتفع في الدنيا ، قاله ابن شجرة

NASAFI:89:23/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:89:23/r1.speaker: قيل
NASAFI:89:23/r1.claim: One explanation is that Hell is brought into view for its inhabitants, as in 26:91.
NASAFI:89:23/r1.anchor: قيل : إنها برزت لأهلها كقوله : { وَبُرّزَتِ الجحيم لِلْغَاوِينَ } [ الشعراء : 91 ]

NASAFI:89:23/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:89:23/r2.speaker: الحديث
NASAFI:89:23/r2.claim: A hadith says Hell will be brought with 70,000 reins, each pulled by 70,000 angels.
NASAFI:89:23/r2.anchor: في الحديث « يؤتى بجهنم يومئذ لها سبعون ألف زمام مع كل زمام سبعون ألف ملك يجرونها »

NASAFI:89:23/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI:89:23/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI:89:23/r3.claim: On that day a person takes heed, but the reminder can no longer benefit him.
NASAFI:89:23/r3.anchor: أي يتعظ { وأنى لَهُ الذكرى } ومن أين له منفعة الذكرى

QURTUBI:89:23/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:89:23/r1.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
QURTUBI:89:23/r1.claim: Ibn Masʿūd and Muqātil report that Hell is dragged by seventy thousand reins, each held by seventy thousand angels, and roars until set to the left of the Throne; Muslim transmits Ibn Masʿūd's report of the reins and angels from the Prophet.
QURTUBI:89:23/r1.anchor: قال ابن مسعود ومقاتل : تقاد جهنم بسبعين ألف زمام ، كل زمام بيد سبعين ألف ملك

QURTUBI:89:23/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:89:23/r2.speaker: أبو سعيد الخدري
QURTUBI:89:23/r2.claim: Abū Saʿīd reports that when this verse was revealed, the Prophet's color changed and his companions noticed; he said Gabriel had recited the preceding verse and this one to him.
QURTUBI:89:23/r2.anchor: وقال أبو سعيد الخدري : لما نزلت " وجيء يومئذ بجهنم " تغير لون رسول الله

QURTUBI:89:23/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:89:23/r3.speaker: علي
QURTUBI:89:23/r3.claim: In ʿAlī's report, Hell is led by the seventy thousand reins and would burn the gathered people if it broke free; presented to Muḥammad, it says God has forbidden his flesh to it, and everyone cries for themselves except Muḥammad, who pleads for his community.
QURTUBI:89:23/r3.anchor: قال علي رضي الله عنه : قلت يا رسول الله ، كيف يجاء بها ؟ قال : ( تؤتى بها تقاد بسبعين ألف زمام

QURTUBI:89:23/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:89:23/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI:89:23/r4.claim: On that day the person recollects in the sense of taking heed and repenting; the person is an unbeliever or someone whose chief concern was worldly life.
QURTUBI:89:23/r4.anchor: قوله تعالى : " يومئذ يتذكر الإنسان " أي يتعظ ويتوب . وهو الكافر

QURTUBI:89:23/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:89:23/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI:89:23/r5.claim: The person has no opportunity for admonition and repentance then, having neglected them in worldly life.
QURTUBI:89:23/r5.anchor: " وأنى له الذكرى " أي ومن أين له الاتعاظ والتوبة وقد فرط فيها في الدنيا

QURTUBI:89:23/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI:89:23/r6.speaker: الزمخشري
QURTUBI:89:23/r6.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī also glosses it as asking how recollection could benefit; an omitted genitive must be supplied, otherwise recollection on that day conflicts with the claim that it is unavailable.
QURTUBI:89:23/r6.anchor: بين " يومئذ يتذكر " وبين " وأنى له الذكرى " تناف . قاله الزمخشري

TAB:89:23/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:89:23/r1.speaker: author
TAB:89:23/r1.claim: Al-Ṭabarī explains the phrase as God coming with Hell on that Day.
TAB:89:23/r1.anchor: يقول تعالى ذكره :  وجاء الله يومئذٍ بجهنم

TAB:89:23/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:89:23/r2.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
TAB:89:23/r2.claim: Ibn Masʿūd reports that Hell is brought with seventy thousand reins, each led by seventy thousand angels.
TAB:89:23/r2.anchor: قال عبد الله بن مسعود ،   في قوله :  وَجِيءَ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِجَهَنّمَ قال :  جيء بها تُقاد بسبعين ألف زمام

TAB:89:23/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:89:23/r3.speaker: أبو وائل
TAB:89:23/r3.claim: Abū Wāʾil likewise says Hell will be led on the Day of Resurrection by seventy thousand reins, with seventy thousand angels per rein.
TAB:89:23/r3.anchor: عن أبي وائل :  وَجِيءَ يَوْمَئذٍ بِجَهَنّمَ قال :  يُجاء بها يوم القيامة تُقاد بسبعين ألف زمام

TAB:89:23/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:89:23/r4.speaker: قتادة
TAB:89:23/r4.claim: Qatada describes Paradise and Hell as the two flanks and says this is when God descends from His Throne to His Kursī to reckon with creation.
TAB:89:23/r4.anchor: عن قتادة ،   قال :  جنَبتيه :  الجنة والنار

TAB:89:23/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:89:23/r5.speaker: قتادة
TAB:89:23/r5.claim: Qatada also says Hell will be brought muzzled.
TAB:89:23/r5.anchor: عن قتادة وَجِيءَ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِجَهنّمَ قال :  جيء بها مزمومة

TAB:89:23/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:89:23/r6.speaker: author
TAB:89:23/r6.claim: On that Day a person recalls neglecting obedience to God and the good deeds that draw him near; ‘how can he be reminded?’ means from what direction can the reminder help him then.
TAB:89:23/r6.anchor: يومئذٍ يتذكر الإنسان تفريطه في الدنيا في طاعة الله

TAB:89:23/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB:89:23/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB:89:23/r7.claim: Ibn Abbas explains ‘how can he be reminded?’ as ‘how can he?’
TAB:89:23/r7.anchor: عن ابن عباس ،   قوله :  وَأنّى لَهُ الذّكْرَى ؟ يقول :  وكيف له ؟

BURHAN:v1p384/r3.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p384/r3.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p384/r3.claim: The extra alif signals that Hell’s coming is an extraordinary, manifest appearance unlike familiar coming; the author links it with its exposure and being seen from afar.
BURHAN:v1p384/r3.anchor: زيدت الألف دليلا على أن هذا المجىء هو بصفة من الظهور ينفصل بها عن معهود المجىء

BURHAN:v3p162/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p162/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v3p162/r1.claim: One kind of omitted object is still intended and recovered from context; a verb or relative clause can require it, so the deletion is understood as ellipsis for brevity.
BURHAN:v3p162/r1.anchor: أحدهما أن يكون مقصودا مع الحذف فينوى لدليل ويقدر في كل موضع ما يليق به

BURHAN:v4p81/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p81/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v4p81/r1.claim: The author distinguishes جاء, used when the arrival is visible or as if witnessed, from أتى for the unseen crops/earth; thus the earth's command comes as أتاها, while the visible command is جاء.

ITQAN:v3p215/r13.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p215/r13.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p215/r13.claim: Interrogation can present something as remote or implausible, as in asking how the reminder could benefit him then.
ITQAN:v3p215/r13.anchor: الثامن والعشرون الاستبعاد نحو ﴿ وأنى له الذكرى ﴾

DAMGHANI:v1p51/r9.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p51/r9.speaker: author

DAMGHANI:v1p51/r9.anchor: العشرون : الإنسان يعني أمية بن خلف . قوله تعالى في سورة الفجر

DURR:89:24/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR:89:24/r1.speaker: الحسن
DURR:89:24/r1.claim: Hasan says that on that day a person knows the warning was true and that the afterlife is a long, deathless life, better than the person's present condition.
DURR:89:24/r1.anchor: عن الحسن رضي الله عنه { يومئذ يتذكر الإنسان } إلى قوله : { لحياتي } قال : علم والله أنه صادق هناك حياة طويلة
